notes.title: Working on VR support
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26623303/864d1815749aff814604cae5a21dc55a6c687c46.jpg

ENGLISH
We gained access to an Oculus Rift DK2 and high-end computer. We had promised there would be Oculus Rift support when we announced the game, we are keeping our promise.


Even though we don't have HTC Vive, I will get help from other studios to test the game on Vive and bring the game to Vive users.


Alongside the VR support, I am working on better performence.


TÜRKÇE

Oculus Rift DK2 cihaza ve yüksek performanslı bilgisayara erişimimiz var artık. Oyunu duyurduğumuzda Oculus Rift desteği konusunda söz vermiştik, sözümüzü tutuyoruz.

HTC Vive'ımız yok, ama oyunu bu cihazda test edip Vive kullanıcılarına da oyunu sunabilmek için başka stüdyolardan yardım alacağız.

VR desteğinin yanında daha iyi performans için de çalışıyorum.

notes.title: Performance, ghost eyes and height fog update
notes.content:
I received feedbacks about the FPS drops in Graveyard Shift. I spent the week to prevent these FPS drops. The game runs better now, but I'll still work on FPS drops.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26623303/67e89a7b94d3ca96a3356864ae2591f82e7654c0.jpg

Now we have better eye lights for enemies. We use self-emitting materials for eyes.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26623303/96c74ca30fc11508916af39ca900f8584fa68281.jpg

And now height fog turns back in this version. We had to remove it because of a Unity bug, but the bug is fixed now. It's available for all platforms.

notes.title: Update on Winter Edition
notes.content:
Merry Christmas! I updated the game to fix a few things.

* I noticed that some of the power-ups didn't spawn in the Winter Edition. Now all the power-ups spawn again.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26623303/ba104573c094cf403000c58bf9221f256e32210c.png

* I changed the water material to a much better one. It reflects the world.

notes.title: Update: All difficulties are unlocked
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26623303/2ec020b5271e226df71d03e5c0365e4ac2758ae3.jpg

With new update, all difficulties are unlocked by default.

We got complaints that the game was too easy. Mushroom elements didn't have an impact on killing the enemies. Because we had wanted the players to complete the game on Easy mode before playing the harder ones. But now you can start from any difficulty you wish.

Have fun!

~Ahmet
